featured_reviews.review_text:
I recently purchased a cricket kit for my 9-year-old daughter from Presi Sports, and I couldn't be more pleased with the experience. From the moment we walked in, the staff was incredibly accommodating and hospitable, making sure we felt welcomed and attended to. They took the time to understand our specific needs and provided excellent recommendations tailored for young players. The quality of the equipment at Presi Sports is top-notch; they truly do not compromise when it comes to offering the best. My daughter was thrilled with her new kit, and it's clear that the materials and craftsmanship are superior.

However, it's worth noting that the prices at Presi Sports can be on the higher side. While this might be a consideration for some, I believe the quality and service justify the cost. In the end, investing in high-quality sports equipment is essential for the safety and performance of young athletes. I highly recommend Presi Sports for anyone looking to purchase cricket gear, especially for children. The experience, quality, and knowledgeable staff make it a standout choice.

featured_reviews.name: afroz hathiyari
featured_reviews.review_text:
Outstanding Service & Expertise – Shakti Sports is the Best!

I can’t recommend Shakti Sports enough! Run by two incredibly passionate and knowledgeable brothers, this is not just a cricket bat store—it’s an experience. They go above and beyond to help every customer find the perfect bat, taking the time to understand individual playing styles and even advising on what wouldn’t suit you, which is rare to find.

I had an issue with a bat I purchased online—it was advertised as lightweight but turned out to be heavy and unbalanced. Instead of just selling me another bat, these experts at Shakti Sports used their skills and deep knowledge to modify and fine-tune it. They carefully reduced the weight, making it 10x better than what the original vendor sold me. The difference in balance and pickup was unreal!

This experience reinforced why it’s so important to support local, family-owned businesses like Shakti Sports instead of blindly chasing big brands. These guys are cricket lovers who genuinely care about their customers, and every purchase helps keep their business thriving. If you’re serious about your cricket gear, forget the mass-market stores and visit Shakti Sports—you won’t regret it!

⭐ 5/5 – The best in the business! ⭐

From cricket bats and footballs to tennis rackets and gym gear, Shakti Sports Shop seems to have it all. The staff is knowledgeable and friendly, offering helpful advice and recommendations based on individual preferences and requirements.

One of the highlights of using Google Maps is the ability to check the store's business hours, ensuring I can plan my visit accordingly. Additionally, I appreciate the user reviews and photos on Google Maps that give me insights into other customers' experiences with the shop.

Overall, Shakti Sports Shop is a must-visit for anyone looking to purchase high-quality sports gear. Thanks to Google Maps, finding and reaching the store was a seamless experience, and I look forward to returning for all my sporting needs in the future. Arrogance would be the perfect way to define my interaction of this place. If you want your self respect to be crushed, visit here and interact with an employee, Mr. Gulab. When i entered the store, he was having a verbal spat with another customer. on his face, this gentleman said, "Sir you are lying" when that person said i get the same thing in some other other shop for Rs. 100 cheaper. I thought, it might be one off case.. and ignored... thats the biggest blunder that i could have done. I was gazing thru different toys (i wanted something for my nephew for his birthday). I found a "foosketball". I asked its price. Mr. Gulab told me, Rs 2000 (thats what the MRP was). Like any other buyer, i logged in, on Amazon to check the price. It was 1750 there. I told him, with a smile, "Aarey Sir, its 250 Rs cheaper online, could i request some discount here". He SNATCHED the toy from my hand, said, "Then buy it online" and kept it at its place.

Result, i bought it online. Yes, i could not meet the birthday but Amazon delivered it the very next day.

The shop has toys, many toys and real good toys. I remember i bought my first videogame (when i was a kid) from this shop, and i remember the smiling face of the employee... and now this arrogance...

Please help me pass this feedback to the owner (who was not in the shop when all this happened).
